## Programming with Intent (PWI)

This project follows PWI. Before you design or implement production code or
tests:

1. Identify the responsibility or behavior you are about to implement.
2. Use the installed PWI capabilities to find the guidance and reference
   implementation for it, then read that implementation together with its tests.
3. Apply the patterns they demonstrate to this project's requirements and
   domain. Do not copy comments that exist only to teach a pattern.
4. Verify the result with the PWI `code-review` skill.

If the PWI capabilities are not installed, say so rather than guessing at them.
Never present work as following PWI when you did not consult its guidance or run
its review.

Project-specific instructions in this file take precedence where they conflict.
<!-- pwi:adoption end -->
